_schema.description: What changed in the tracker's data, newest first, written by scripts/refresh.py after each refresh by comparing the data with the previous run. Entries older than 120 days are dropped.

fields.updated: ISO UTC time of the last run that changed anything
fields.entries: [{date (Melbourne YYYY-MM-DD), at (ISO UTC), type, ...}] where type is one of: candidate_added {seat, name, party, status, source}; candidate_superseded {seat, name, party, by}; candidate_withdrawn {seat, name, party}; poll_added {id, pollster, end_date, tpp (L/NP), primary}; odds_move {seat, label, party, from, to} (a price moving 0.5 or more); retirement {seat, name}; news {count} (new headlines collected)
